_about: 새 당번 사원 디자인 시안. make_character.py 가 이 목록으로 기준 그림 시안을 그린다 (고른 뒤 bible.json에 정식 등록).

candidates.label: 냥 사원 A안 — 치즈 고양이
candidates.look: an orange tabby cat with clear darker orange stripes, a white chest and white muzzle, sharp green eyes that are usually half-lidded, pointed ears, slim build, long striped tail. Wears a white dress shirt with the top button undone, a burgundy knit vest, black slacks, black shoes, and a white employee ID card on a navy lanyard.
candidates.attitude: prickly and aloof: arms crossed, chin slightly raised, one ear turned back, unimpressed half-lidded stare

candidates.label: 냥 사원 B안 — 회색 단모 고양이
candidates.look: a sleek blue-gray short-haired cat with no stripes, a slightly lighter gray muzzle, sharp amber-yellow eyes that are usually half-lidded, pointed ears, slim build, long smooth gray tail. Wears a black turtleneck under a charcoal blazer, charcoal slacks, black shoes, and a white employee ID card on a navy lanyard. No glasses.
candidates.attitude: prickly and aloof: arms crossed, chin slightly raised, one ear turned back, cool unimpressed stare

candidates.label: 냥 사원 C안 — 턱시도 고양이
candidates.look: a tuxedo cat with black fur, a white muzzle, white chest and white paws like gloves, sharp yellow-green eyes that are usually half-lidded, pointed ears, slim build, long black tail. Wears a white dress shirt, a loosened wine-red tie, light gray slacks, black shoes, and a white employee ID card on a navy lanyard.
candidates.attitude: prickly and aloof: arms crossed, chin slightly raised, one ear turned back, unimpressed half-lidded stare

candidates.label: 뭉뭉 인턴 A안 — 정수리 리본 요크셔테리어
candidates.look: a Yorkshire terrier puppy with long silky fur, sharp contrast between the steel blue-gray back and the golden-tan face, chest, legs and ears, small black button nose, round shiny dark eyes, small upright pointed ears, the hair on top of the head tied up in a small topknot with a tiny red bow. Wears a mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a white collared shirt, khaki chinos, white sneakers, and a white employee ID card on a bright yellow lanyard.
candidates.attitude: eager new intern: wide bright eyes, big smile, full of energy
candidates.pose: small and short, about a head shorter than the otter, standing energetically with one paw raised in a small fist, tail up and wagging
candidates.expressions: 1) a bright eager smile with sparkling eyes, 2) a flustered face with a small sweat drop, staring at a smartphone held in both paws, 3) a proud excited grin with eyes closed
